description: Pittston, PA – The Rob Bresnahan for Congress campaign today released a new TV ad, Rain Tax, highlighting Congressman Rob Bresnahan’s fight to end the federal Rain Tax mandate that drained the wallets of homeowners and small business owners in Northeastern Pennsylvania for over a decade.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Rob for PA
title: Congressman Rob Bresnahan’s Campaign Releases New TV Ad On His Work to End the Federal Rain Tax Mandate - Rob for PA
